user.title: Set up WP Log Doctor
user.description: WP Log Doctor scans your Home Assistant log, matches problems against a built-in knowledge base, and reports what it finds. It never changes your configuration. Set an OpenAI API key to also automatically investigate anomalies with an OpenAI model after each scan.

data.restart_grace_minutes: Startup messages: count messages logged up to this many minutes after Home Assistant has finished starting
data.restart_history_open_entries: Restart history: restarts to keep open (older ones are archived automatically)
data.report_retention_days: Days to keep old report files on disk
data.include_supervisor_logs: Also check Supervisor, Host, and add-on logs (Home Assistant OS/Supervised only)
data.monitor_automations: Notify me when any automation or script fails
data.monitor_missed_schedules: After a restart, tell me about time-scheduled automations that were missed while Home Assistant was offline
data.missed_schedule_min_pattern_minutes: Skip time pattern triggers that repeat more often than every … minutes (0 = check all)
data.monitor_health: Watch for offline devices, failed integrations and Repairs issues
data.offline_hours: Report devices offline for at least (hours)
data.automation_failure_notify_device: Also push automation failures and missed schedules to this phone (Mobile App device, optional)
data.openai_api_key: OpenAI API key (optional - enables automatic investigation of each scan's anomalies)
data.max_investigated: Max anomalies investigated per scan (only used when an OpenAI API key is set)
data.monitor_stopped_automations: Tell me when an automation that usually runs regularly stops running
data.flap_count: Report devices that go unavailable at least this many times (0 = off)…

scan_now.name: Scan now
scan_now.description: Immediately scan the Home Assistant log for anomalies, outside of the daily schedule. Only reports findings - never changes any configuration.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Forget which anomalies have already been reported. The next scan will treat everything it finds as new.

send_weekly_digest.name: Send weekly digest
send_weekly_digest.description: Send the weekly digest (the last seven days) now, as a notification and to the daily summary's notify service if one is set.
